title: Switch IOS Upgrade
description: Understand the IOS upgrade process and verify the running image.
scenario: Understand the IOS upgrade process and verify the running image.

concepts.title: IOS Image
concepts.body: The IOS image is stored in flash. "show version" shows the running image and version.
concepts.code:
SW1# show version
System image file is "flash:c2960-lanbasek9-mz.122-55.SE11.bin"

concepts.title: Upgrade Process
concepts.body: Copy new IOS to flash, set boot statement, reload. Verify with "show version".
concepts.code:
copy tftp: flash:
boot system flash:new-image.bin
reload

concepts.title: Boot Settings
concepts.body: "show boot" shows which image loads on boot. Multiple images can be configured as fallback.
concepts.code:
SW1# show boot
BOOT path-list: flash:c2960-lanbasek9-mz.122-55.SE11.bin
